name: Al Industrial Components
old_description: At Alabama Industrial Components, Inc., we pride ourselves on offering the highest quality hyrdraulic and pneumatic components and services that will meet your company's needs.  Please contact us to experience for yourself the quality that has satisfied the needs of customers in Alabama and Mississippi for over sixteen years.
about:
Based in Remlap, Alabama, Alabama Industrial Components, Inc. has supplied hydraulic and pneumatic components and services to customers across Alabama and Mississippi for more than sixteen years. The business operates as a distributor and service provider for fluid power equipment.

The company’s product portfolio covers hydraulic motors, pumps, valves, hose assemblies, reservoir accessories, and gauges from Fluid Components, Inc.; hydraulic seals, kits, and components from Hydraulics; and valves, quick couplings, and gauges from Components, Inc. It also offers general industrial tools and supplies from Distribution Partners LLC, including brands such as IR and DeWalt. In addition to sales, the firm provides service support for the product lines it carries.

Its customer base consists of industrial facilities in Alabama and Mississippi that require fluid power components for maintenance, repair, and operations. The company specifically lists fittings and adapters among the industries it serves.

Alabama Industrial Components states that it prides itself on offering the highest quality hydraulic and pneumatic components and services to meet its customers’ needs. The company’s website highlights its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, noting that it has satisfied the needs of customers in the region for over sixteen years.
